# Identity v3

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's identity/v3 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.IdentityV3(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.identity`).

Package docs describe the service and its resources (`go doc ./identity/v3/...`). SDK-owned [`EndpointGroups`](endpointgroups/README.md), [`IdentityProviders`](identityproviders/README.md), [`FederationProtocols`](federationprotocols/README.md) and [`ServiceProviders`](serviceproviders/README.md) cover OS-EP-FILTER and OS-FEDERATION. [Identity finding](../../docs/finding-identities.md) explains name and ID resolution.

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.IdentityV3(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Users.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Users.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
